title: PocketGull Typeface Superfamily: Optotypically Calibrated Clinical & Ophthalmological Vector Letterforms
description: PocketGull is an open-source clinical and ophthalmological vector typeface superfamily designed for digital health applications, critical care telemetry readouts, and assistive reading. Engineered on a 1000 UPM grid with LogMAR 0.0 Snellen optotypic legibility, PocketGull features 256 Unicode Braille patterns (U+2800..U+28FF), ISMP/FDA numeral disambiguation (slashed zero, curved lowercase l, serifed capital I), unified baseline metric curves, and multi-script coverage across Latin, Greek, Cyrillic, and medical telemetry symbols.
